manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside a velocity-time graph. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope, the acceleration, is still -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: Left, a ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. Right, the velocity-time line with a linked marker and the slope segment. The gravitational force equals mass times gravity.
